title: RAMageddon: Qualcomm planning 'double-digit' price increases
content_html:
The general perception of RAMageddon has been, for a while now, that it will get worse before it gets better. Qualcomm is seemingly confirming that.

Bloomberg reported on Friday that the chip maker, whose chips can be found in all of Samsung's new foldables, Windows laptops, and smartwatches, has reportedly told clients to expect a price increase on its products for anything shipped after Sept. 1. The specific size of the price increase is not known at this time, but Bloomberg said it will be a percentage in the double digits, so it's not a small one.

All of this, of course, was attributed to rising memory component costs due to the AI spending spree. AI companies are in the midst of a huge data center construction boom, and the industry requires massive amounts of memory. This phenomenon, commonly called RAMageddon, has contributed to a wave of price increases across the tech industry, and it doesn't show any signs of slowing down.

In our previous reporting on the global memory crisis, experts have told Mashable the situation will likely get worse before it gets better. International Data Corporation research manager Jitesh Ubrani told Mashable earlier this year that relief will likely not happen until at least 2028, and even then, don't expect much.

"The memory supply will remain tight from a device's perspective for the remainder of 2026 and well into 2027," Ubrani told Mashable in May. "We will see some alleviation in 2028, but keep in mind that prices will continue to rise throughout. And even in 2028, assuming this new [memory] capacity comes online and is able to provide some alleviation, we don't see device prices dropping significantly."

In other words: Ouch. Not good.

content_html_zh:
一段时间以来，人们普遍认为拉米吉登的情况在好转之前会变得更糟。 高通似乎证实了这一点。

彭博社周五报道称，这家芯片制造商已告诉客户，预计 9 月 1 日之后发货的所有产品的价格都会上涨。三星所有的新款可折叠手机、Windows 笔记本电脑和智能手表都采用了该芯片制造商的芯片。 目前还不清楚涨价的具体幅度，但彭博社表示，将是两位数的百分比，因此涨幅不小。

当然，所有这一切都归因于人工智能支出热潮导致内存组件成本上升。 人工智能公司正处于数据中心建设的巨大热潮中，该行业需要大量的内存。 这种现象通常被称为“RAMgeddon”，引发了整个科技行业的价格上涨浪潮，而且没有任何放缓的迹象。

在我们之前关于全球内存危机的报道中，专家告诉 Mashable，情况在好转之前可能会变得更糟。 国际数据公司研究经理 Jitesh Ubrani 今年早些时候告诉 Mashable，至少要到 2028 年才会出现缓解，即使到那时，也不要抱太大希望。

Ubrani 在 5 月份对 Mashable 表示：“从设备的角度来看，2026 年剩余时间和 2027 年内存供应将保持紧张。” “我们将在 2028 年看到一些缓解，但请记住，价格将继续上涨。 即使到 2028 年，假设这种新的[内存]容量上线并能够提供一定的缓解，我们也不会看到设备价格大幅下降。”

换句话说：哎哟。 不好。
